headline: A YES vote keeps Chapter 135 — including the expanded assault-weapons definition.

items.title: Owned before Aug 1, 2024? You keep your AR-15.
Who already owns: white men 48%, nonwhite women 16% (Pew 2017).
items.detail: Who's buying next: 56% of Black non-owners see themselves owning a gun — the highest of any group (Pew 2023).

items.title: The legal alternative fires the same round.
items.detail: The banned 'features' are the adjustability — the stock and grip geometry that lets a smaller shooter fit the rifle.

sources: Sources: Pew Research 2017/2023 · Acts of 2024, Ch. 135 · mass.gov
